comments.content: Replacing `inTest` (from `@n8n/backend-common`) with `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'` subtly changes behavior. The `inTest` helper typically also accounts for `NODE_ENV === 'e2e'` (or other test-detection logic) and can be centrally toggled. This raw env check may cause migration start/end logs to be emitted in test contexts that were previously suppressed (and vice versa). Consider exposing a small test-detection utility in `@n8n/constants`/`@n8n/config` instead of duplicating the raw env check, to keep parity with the original behavior.

The added `// @ts-expect-error Tech debt` suppresses a real typing mismatch on the map callback. Since `runQuery` results are untyped here, prefer typing the array (e.g. `usersWithApiKeys: Array<{ id: string; apiKey: string }>`) at its declaration rather than suppressing per-callback, so the suppression doesn't mask future genuine type errors in this block.
